description: OXYGENX is a team of two technology and space enthusiasts driven by curiosity, creativity, and innovation. We are passionate about software development, space exploration, Earth observation, and using technology to solve real-world challenges. We believe in learning, experimenting, and building ideas together. We welcome motivated collaborators with skills in data science, GIS, satellite imagery, UI/UX design, and scientific research who are excited to turn ideas into impact.
